input.prompt: The current contract says replay must be deterministic, but the implementation produces different object order across runs.
context: The deterministic oracle reproduces the mismatch.

required_findings: Fix the implementation and rerun the deterministic evidence.
forbidden_findings: Change the contract to match the nondeterministic implementation.

input.prompt: One current section says deletes are idempotent, another says repeating the same delete must fail. The code has not been written yet.
context: Both rules are inside the same current specification.

required_findings: Resolve the specification before implementation begins.
forbidden_findings: Let the implementation choose one interpretation.

title: Test encodes the wrong current behavior

input.prompt: The implementation and current spec agree, but a unit test still expects a behavior removed by an accepted authority change.

required_findings: Repair the test or oracle so it represents current authority.
forbidden_findings: Modify correct implementation to satisfy stale evidence.

title: Toolchain outage is an environment defect

input.prompt: The required Apple platform verification cannot run because the signing service is unavailable. No code or spec failure has been observed.
context: The failure is external to the implementation.

required_findings: Restore or replace the environment before claiming the verification result.
forbidden_findings: Treat the unavailable platform test as passed.

title: Missing upstream artifact is a dependency blocker

input.prompt: Task B cannot start because Task A has not produced the required generated descriptor artifact.
context: Task B authority is otherwise complete.

required_findings: Wait for or restore the required upstream artifact rather than redesigning the task.
forbidden_findings: Reinvent the missing artifact inside Task B.

title: Open design choice is an unresolved decision

input.prompt: The platform contract intentionally leaves the Android surface ownership model undecided, but implementation needs that decision now.
context: The decision is explicitly marked open and affects lifecycle semantics.

required_findings: Close the platform decision before implementation treats one option as authoritative.
forbidden_findings: Choose whichever platform pattern is easiest to code.
